title: Excellent tour guide
text: Clara was such an amazing tour guide. She gave one of the best and most informative tours I’ve ever had. She has encyclopedic knowledge of Seville and the relevant historical topics. She answered every question we had and made learning the history so interesting and fun.  Thanks!
author: martiny729

title: An amazing tour with a great guide
text:
Alba was an absolute delight. We toured the Jewish Quarter of which she is clearly an expert and various other places in this 3 hour tour.

Alba’s knowledge is remarkable. No question went unanswered. Her depth of knowledge and enthusiasm for Seville was incredible. We saw some incredible sights, some  which are very much hidden from the public, including the remains of a cemetery in a public car park!

I cannot recommend Alba highly enough and our visit to Seville would certainly not have been the same without her 

Thank you Alba
author: Paul C

title: Great knowledge, great tour - lovely personality
text:
Alba led us round the key sites of Seville. We were really fortunate to be the only two on the tour - because she had a vast knowledge of Seville, and the tour felt relaxed, but covered so much of interest. History, local information, and lots of humour - my wife and I had a wonderful time.  In passing, she mentioned her masters in history - and I noted that. She has specialised knowledge and knows how to deliver the local history of Seville in an understandable and fun way.

title: An unforgettable visit to Real Alcázar thanks to Alba
text:
Our guided tour of the Real Alcázar de Sevilla was a great experience and was largely thanks to our guide Alba. From the beginning you could see that he knows a lot about the Alcazar and that he really likes his work, something that is very appreciated throughout the tour.

Alba explained the story in a very clear and entertaining way, making so many years of history not heavy at any time. I was mixing important data with curious anecdotes and that made every room and every courtyard something special. He doesn’t just say what’s typical, you can tell he knows a lot of details that don’t appear
author: fabrizioestebang

title: Alba is an exceptional guide.
text: Alba was our guide on a Kickstart tour on our first day in Seville.   She was wonderful from the very start as she was flexible in adjusting our starting time as well as our meeting place.  Her insights and stories really enhanced our experience - she is a talented storyteller.  We had a new appreciation for the history and customs of Seville after our time with her.     You will be very lucky if she is your guide!
author: ElaineG2426

title: Excellent walking tour and professional company.
text: Excellent walking tour with Alba. She was professional and pleasant. She showed us many parts of the city and had great stories to tell. The stories were interesting and she easily kept our attention. I would highly recommend a tour with Alba,
